features: Steam-inspired blue desktop chrome, Library/Discover/Saved/Arcade navigation
Cinematic rotating spotlights with previous/next/pause and official screenshot hover previews
Personal recommendations, recently viewed, saved and play-next shelves
Searchable complete title sidebar and real back/forward filter history
Right-click card actions, detail section navigation and filter-aware random discovery
Big Picture keyboard navigation and browser fullscreen
Live background Canvas creatures playing Snackball without intercepting library input
Playable Snackball with movement, aim, returning donut throws, star collection, collision scoring, combos, 60-active-second rounds and a saved high score
Draggable/resizable desktop-style arcade inside the browser, touch joystick/throw controls and viewport clamping
Independent motion, background activity, spotlight, hover, sound and focus settings; audio off by default
Midnight, sunset and mint scenes; reduced-motion support; animation suspension when hidden or obscured

browserStorage.scope: Local browser/device. No automatic cross-device sync or native Steam account connection.

completeArcadeRound.method: Real keyboard input and collision scoring through Playwright virtual animation frames

verification.previewType: Actual production browser recording with real keyboard/pointer input, not generated imagery or a synthetic mockup
verification.limitation: Selected real trailer playback is not a claim that every external video was watched end to end. This is a desktop-style game inside the library, not an operating-system wallpaper or native Steam-client integration.

pages.blocker: GitHub Pages remains disabled. Native wiki and portable HTML are published; enable Settings > Pages > Source: GitHub Actions to host the interactive site.

driveBackup.matches: Exact Games-Lounge-Delivery.zip GitHub release asset, including the full release-and-verification archive and actual motion preview

nextAction: No remaining implementation or release gate. Reuse catalog-39 and the same data/storage IDs for requested future changes. Hosting enablement is separate. Do not restart discovery, repeat passed suites without a source invalidator, or re-upload unchanged bytes.
